item.title: Not just surviving
item.description: "When we were using, our lives became an exercise in survival. Now we are doing much more living than surviving." Just for Today: I am grateful to be alive. I will do something today to celebrate.
item.content:encoded:
When we were using, our lives became an exercise in survival. Now we are doing much more living than surviving.

Basic Text, p. 52

Just for Today: I am grateful to be alive. I will do something today to celebrate.
